13: const now = () => Date.now();

15: export interface CreateListingResult {

17:   warning?: string;

20: function insertListingRow(input: ListingCreateInput, created: number): ListingRow {
21:   const db = getDb();
22:   const row: NewListingRow = {
23:     serverId: input.serverId,
24:     userId: input.userId,
25:     username: input.username,
26:     intent: input.intent,
27:     accepts: input.accepts,
28:     game: input.game ?? 'mtg',

35:     collectorNumber: input.collectorNumber ?? null,
36:     manapoolUrl: input.manapoolUrl ?? null,
37:     condition: input.condition ?? null,
38:     priceCents: input.priceCents ?? null,

40:     sealedUuid: input.sealedUuid ?? null,
41:     sealedCategory: input.sealedCategory ?? null,
42:     sealedSubtype: input.sealedSubtype ?? null,
43:     quantity: input.quantity ?? 1,
44:     notes: input.notes ?? null,
45:     status: 'active',
46:     expiresAt: created + LISTING_TTL_MS,
47:     createdAt: created,
48:     updatedAt: created,
49:   };
50:   return db.insert(listings).values(row).returning().get();
51: }

53: /**
54:  * Create an active listing after applying the cooldown and duplicate guards.
55:  * Throws a human-readable error when the user is on cooldown.
56:  */
57: export function createListing(input: ListingCreateInput): CreateListingResult {
58:   const created = now();
59:   const warning = duplicateWarning(input, created);
60:   enforceCooldown(input.serverId, input.userId, created);
61:   const inserted = insertListingRow(input, created);
62:   return { listing: inserted, warning };
63: }
64: 
65: /**
66:  * Create several listings from one batch submission. The cooldown is checked once
67:  * for the whole batch rather than once per card, since cards created milliseconds
68:  * apart within the same submission would otherwise trip each other's cooldown.
69:  * Throws the same cooldown error as `createListing` if the batch itself is blocked;
70:  * otherwise every input is inserted (duplicate warnings still apply per card).
71:  */
72: export function createListingsBatch(inputs: ListingCreateInput[]): CreateListingResult[] {
73:   const [first] = inputs;
74:   if (!first) {
75:     return [];
76:   }
77:   const created = now();
78:   enforceCooldown(first.serverId, first.userId, created);
79:   return inputs.map((input) => {
80:     const warning = duplicateWarning(input, created);
81:     const inserted = insertListingRow(input, created);
82:     return { listing: inserted, warning };
83:   });
84: }
85: 
86: function enforceCooldown(serverId: string, userId: string, at: number): void {
87:   const db = getDb();
88:   const last = db
89:     .select({ createdAt: listings.createdAt })
90:     .from(listings)
91:     .where(and(eq(listings.serverId, serverId), eq(listings.userId, userId)))
92:     .orderBy(desc(listings.createdAt))
93:     .limit(1)
94:     .all()
95:     .at(0);
96:   if (last && at - last.createdAt < LISTING_COOLDOWN_MS) {
97:     const wait = Math.ceil((LISTING_COOLDOWN_MS - (at - last.createdAt)) / 1000);
98:     throw new Error(
99:       `You are posting too quickly. Try again in ${wait} second${wait === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`,
100:     );
101:   }
102: }
103: 
104: function duplicateWarning(input: ListingCreateInput, at: number): string | undefined {
105:   const db = getDb();
106:   const windowStart = at - DUPLICATE_WINDOW_MS;
107:   const dup = db
108:     .select({ id: listings.id })
109:     .from(listings)
110:     .where(
111:       and(
112:         eq(listings.serverId, input.serverId),
113:         eq(listings.userId, input.userId),
114:         eq(listings.status, 'active'),
115:         eq(listings.cardNameNormalized, input.cardNameNormalized),
116:         eq(listings.intent, input.intent),
117:         eq(listings.accepts, input.accepts),
118:         eq(listings.kind, input.kind ?? 'card'),
119:         sql`${listings.finish} IS ${input.finish ?? null}`,
120:         sql`${listings.variant} IS ${input.variant ?? null}`,
121:         sql`${listings.collectorNumber} IS ${input.collectorNumber ?? null}`,
122:         sql`${listings.condition} IS ${input.condition ?? null}`,
123:         sql`${listings.priceCents} IS ${input.priceCents ?? null}`,
124:         gte(listings.createdAt, windowStart),
125:       ),
126:     )
127:     .get();
128:   if (dup) {
129:     return `Note: you already have an active matching listing (#${dup.id}) posted in the last 24 hours.`;
130:   }
131:   return undefined;
132: }

134: /** Search active listings in a server with pagination, newest first. */
135: export function searchListings(
136:   serverId: string,
137:   cardNameNormalized: string,
138:   intent: ListingIntent | undefined,
139:   accepts: Accepts | undefined,
140:   page: number,
141: ): ListingRow[] {
142:   const db = getDb();
143:   const conditions = searchConditions(serverId, cardNameNormalized, intent, accepts);
144:   const offset = Math.max(0, page - 1) * SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE;
145:   return db
146:     .select()
147:     .from(listings)
148:     .where(and(...conditions))
149:     .orderBy(desc(listings.createdAt))
150:     .limit(SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE)
151:     .offset(offset)
152:     .all();
153: }
154: 
155: /** Count matching active listings for pagination. */
156: export function countSearchResults(
157:   serverId: string,
158:   cardNameNormalized: string,
159:   intent: ListingIntent | undefined,
160:   accepts: Accepts | undefined,
161: ): number {
162:   const db = getDb();
163:   const conditions = searchConditions(serverId, cardNameNormalized, intent, accepts);
164:   const row = db
165:     .select({ value: count() })
166:     .from(listings)
167:     .where(and(...conditions))
168:     .get();
169:   return row?.value ?? 0;
170: }
171: 
172: function searchConditions(
173:   serverId: string,
174:   cardNameNormalized: string,
175:   intent?: ListingIntent,
176:   accepts?: Accepts,
177: ) {
178:   const conditions = [
179:     eq(listings.serverId, serverId),
180:     eq(listings.status, 'active'),
181:     eq(listings.cardNameNormalized, cardNameNormalized),
182:   ];
183:   if (intent) {
184:     conditions.push(eq(listings.intent, intent));
185:   }
186:   if (accepts) {
187:     // A listing that accepts 'both' should match a filter for either 'cash'
188:     // or 'trade'; only an exact 'both' filter should require 'both' itself.
189:     const clause =
190:       accepts === 'both'
191:         ? eq(listings.accepts, 'both')
192:         : or(eq(listings.accepts, accepts), eq(listings.accepts, 'both'));
193:     if (clause) {
194:       conditions.push(clause);
195:     }
196:   }
197:   return conditions;
198: }

212:       ),
213:     )
214:     .orderBy(desc(listings.createdAt))

218: }

249: export function updateListing(

261:     manapoolUrl?: string | null;
262:     sealedUuid?: string | null;
263:     sealedCategory?: string | null;
264:     sealedSubtype?: string | null;
265:   },

267:   const db = getDb();
268:   const update: Partial<NewListingRow> = { updatedAt: now() };
269:   if (fields.condition !== undefined) update.condition = fields.condition;
270:   if (fields.priceCents !== undefined) update.priceCents = fields.priceCents;
271:   if (fields.quantity !== undefined) update.quantity = fields.quantity;
272:   if (fields.notes !== undefined) update.notes = fields.notes;
273:   if (fields.cardSet !== undefined) update.cardSet = fields.cardSet;
274:   if (fields.cardName !== undefined) update.cardName = fields.cardName;
275:   if (fields.cardNameNormalized !== undefined)
276:     update.cardNameNormalized = fields.cardNameNormalized;
277:   if (fields.cardImageUrl !== undefined) update.cardImageUrl = fields.cardImageUrl;
278:   if (fields.collectorNumber !== undefined) update.collectorNumber = fields.collectorNumber;
279:   if (fields.manapoolUrl !== undefined) update.manapoolUrl = fields.manapoolUrl;
280:   if (fields.sealedUuid !== undefined) update.sealedUuid = fields.sealedUuid;
281:   if (fields.sealedCategory !== undefined) update.sealedCategory = fields.sealedCategory;
282:   if (fields.sealedSubtype !== undefined) update.sealedSubtype = fields.sealedSubtype;
283:   db.update(listings).set(update).where(eq(listings.id, id)).run();
284:   return getListingById(id);
285: }

288: export function fulfillListing(id: number): ListingRow | undefined {
